_meta: Hindi Approach B rewrites for 3x+ duplicate clusters. Each rewrite uses the original card's name in a NEW sentence at similar difficulty. Three clusters had gender-agreement bugs (female name + masculine verb) — fixed by re-canonicalizing to the gender-correct member and rewriting all others including the original canonical.
